title: Built-in voice recognition and commands
summary: Feedback on the G60's voice interface centers on command recognition quality, with clear complaints about misheard commands but many sampled mentions that are too brief or procedural to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive feedback says the verbal command system works well and can be convenient and effective to use.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on the built-in voice recognition misinterpreting or failing to recognize commands, including numbers, and being frustrating in use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions include brief statements about voice commands or the personal assistant, plus some ambiguous praise or criticism that lacks enough context for a firm sentiment assignment.

limitations: Most sampled mentions are assigned undetermined sentiment, which limits confidence in describing the overall tone beyond the explicit negative examples.
Several negative fragments are template-like problem labels with limited detail about the exact user scenario or feature behavior.
At least one negative example appears to mix voice recognition with another function, so the cluster may include some adjacent interface issues rather than a single tightly defined problem.
